rows.label: tlk43700241_01_msg0002
rows.name: You really helped me out before.

rows.label: tlk43700241_01_msg0003
rows.name:
I lost because I wasn't able to
fully make use of my Assist Cores.

rows.label: tlk43700241_01_msg0004
rows.name:
I could have used fire-damage
reduction to weaken Heaven's Holy
Grail's attacks...

rows.label: tlk43700241_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Or I could have used a jamming effect
to dodge ranged attacks. If I'd done
something like that, I would have won!

rows.label: tlk43700241_01_msg0006
rows.name:
That's not to say I'm going to try
it, but believe me, it's true!
